{{Top|leg}}
A '''disrupter box''' was a piece of technology that was essential on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Zeta Zero Nine]]. This was due to most technology being disabled by the planet's strong magnetic field and constant electromagnetic storms. Most of the underwater craft stationed at the [[Underwater Zeta Zero Nine base|underwater base]] on the planet were equipped with these devices.
